summary: Seasonal Slides feature tested end-to-end. Backend (pytest, 13 tests): 12 passed. Public list filtering (active/not deleted/date window incl. today boundaries, open-ended), admin CRUD, image ?v increment, soft delete -> 404 image, auth 401/403, validation 422 for missing photo/title, bad mime, bad date, end<start, 404 unknown id all OK. One minor failure: non-numeric 'order' -> 500. Frontend (static Expo build at :8090): guest carousel with 1 live slide shows no counter/arrows/dots; with 2 slides shows 1/2, next/prev, dots and ~5s auto-advance all work; with 0 live slides it falls back to the 4 defaults (1/4, wrap-around prev, dot nav, auto-advance, mobile 390px hides arrows). Admin: Services tab 'Home Slides' button -> /admin-hero-slides, 'Missing photo' validation toast, file chooser upload with preview, create, edit (prefilled), 'Starts YYYY-MM-DD' / 'Off' / 'Live now' badges, toggle, delete with confirm modal, and info box live count all work. DB left with only the original 'Furnace not heating?' slide (active).

minor.issue: order='abc' (non-numeric) -> 500 because of int(payload['order']) in _hero_fields. Should return 422. The UI strips non-digits, so this only affects direct API calls.
Doesn't filter is_deleted, so deleting an already-deleted slide returns 200 instead of 404 (cosmetic).
Bytes aren't checked to be a real image (b64decode without validate=True; mime comes only from the data-URL header). Consider validate=True plus a magic-byte check.

ui_bugs.issue: react-native-web 0.21 does not forward the 'data-testid' prop, so none of hero-carousel, hero-counter, hero-next-btn, hero-dot-N, hero-slide-* exist in the DOM. Tests had to use text, aria-label and placeholder selectors. Use testID='...' (RN-web renders it as data-testid). This is a codebase-wide pattern.

integration_issues.flow: Admin session after a full page reload (pre-existing, not part of this feature)
integration_issues.issue: store/authStore.ts hardcodes API_BASE='https://backend-production-a461.up.railway.app/api' for /auth/me in loadToken(). On the local :8090 build a hard reload sends the local token to prod, gets a 401 and deleteToken() clears it. Admin GET happened to work by racing ahead, but the later POST from /admin-hero-slides failed with 401 (seen in backend log). In-app navigation works fine. In prod both URLs point to the same backend, so users are unaffected, but authStore should use the same EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL as utils/api.ts.

action_items: Replace data-testid props with testID in HeroCarousel.tsx and admin-hero-slides.tsx so the test ids appear in the DOM on web
Optional: make store/authStore.ts API_BASE use process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL (same as utils/api.ts) to avoid clearing the session on reload in non-prod builds
critical_code_review_comments: server.py admin_delete_hero_slide: should match is_deleted != True for proper 404
server.py _decode_hero_image: no real image validation; b64decode is lenient
Today is computed in UTC on both backend and admin UI (consistent), but slides switch at UTC midnight, not local midnight. Fine but worth noting for US users.
authStore.ts hardcoded prod API_BASE (pre-existing) differs from utils/api.ts env-based URL

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (data-testid attributes missing in the DOM)

seed_data_creation: Test slides created were all deleted. The 'Furnace not heating?' slide was toggled off temporarily to test the defaults, then turned back on.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use http://localhost:8001/api for the backend and http://localhost:8090 for the Expo web build. data-testid props are NOT rendered by RN-web, so use get_by_text, get_by_label('Next slide'/'Previous slide'/'Slide N') and get_by_placeholder ('Heating', 'Furnace not heating?', 'Get warm again today.', '2026-11-01', '2027-02-28'). After UI login, do NOT page.goto a protected route (a full reload clears the token through authStore's prod /auth/me call). Navigate in-app instead: Services tab -> 'Home Slides'. The delete confirm is an in-app modal ('Delete' button), and alerts are toasts. The admin upload file chooser works with page.expect_file_chooser.
rca of the issue: The 401 on POST /api/admin/hero-slides during UI testing came from store/authStore.ts loadToken() calling the hardcoded prod URL /auth/me on reload. Prod rejects the local token with 401 and deleteToken() removes localStorage.session_token, so later axios calls go out without Authorization. Repro: log in at :8090/login, page.goto(':8090/admin-hero-slides'), save a slide -> 401. Fix: use the env API URL in authStore.
